item.title: Website refonte with Hugo (part 2)
item.description: The first version put the CV and a few posts online with Hugo. This rebuild gives the CV, articles and repository notes a shared visual identity, while keeping a layout suited to each kind of reading. It follows Create a portfolio with Hugo (week 1).

item.title: Create a portfolio with Hugo (week 1)
item.description: Week one of moving my site to Hugo (January 2024): pick a theme, ship something fast, and prove the repo could carry more than a PDF résumé. This post is the log — HBTheme, a data story embed, Substack in parallel, and a reusable iframe shortcode.
